mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that accelerates inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 5.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both increase by more than 1% in the same month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating a supply shock that increases economic uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 95.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY increase > 3.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS remains above its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases inflation expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.5pp in a month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a manufacturing contraction, which increases recession risks and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 95.0 for two consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
